about: The third review of 1.24.17's rules (2026-11-13), by an agent that had seen neither the rules written nor the two reviews before it: 309 cases of its own on CONVERT's unit names (rule 1: the imperial reading beside an imperial measure and the plain pint, new after the second review), the history's short versions (2) and the runaway chord line (3). Each case has what it expected, what it got on the build it tried, and (rule 1) what 1.24.16 gave; 'now' is how it comes out after its findings were mended (tests/bench_1257.js replays rule 1). It found Lantern's own names (pint_us) read as plain, 'gallons' to 'imperial gallons' read as 1, 'sqft' lost, lines beginning 'Make' in prose named as blocks, the person's 'This is not what I asked' taken for Lantern's, Lantern's own 'That is already above ... QUESTION: <old>' kept, and the chords cut under a tune written on a part's line. Mended: see CHANGELOG 1.24.17.

known.R2: as Lantern's block reader takes them: a Lua program's inner bare 'end' ends the block, and a MAKE line inside a code block starts another; as on 1.24.16: a picture kept in view (keepPicture) is dropped once it is older than the room
